explanation: At D1 and GO the unit sits at 10 no matter what happened (now and then 9 at D1), and at D2 its value depends mainly on the choice just made: about 9-10 after choosing a2 (around 8-9 after a2 leads to a rare S1), but about 0-1 after a1 leads to a common S1 (up to 2-3 if a1 was chosen several trials in a row). After a1 leads to a rare S2 it is in the middle, usually 3-5 and sometimes up to 8, while rewards and time in the episode barely matter.
